name: author-voice
description: Draft and revise research papers and books in the author's voice, with evidence and technical detail preserved.

interface.shortDescription: Natural manuscript prose with evidence preserved.
interface.longDescription: Write directly in an author's voice or revise existing manuscripts. Includes paper and book guidance, portable voice profiles, and an optional offline preservation checker.
defaultPrompt: Revise this paper while preserving its evidence and my voice.
Draft a book section from these notes in a clear, natural voice.
Build a reusable voice profile from my writing samples.
